To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have successfully designed, synthesized and evaluated the anticancer activity of new series of hydroxamates with alkylpieridine and alkyl piperazine scaffold and found that the piperazinoyl urea containing compound is more selective towards HDAC8 than HDAC3 and has better cytotoxic potential against cancer cell lines.
a series of novel hydroxamic acids have been synthesized, characterized and biologically evaluated for HDAC8 inhibiting and anticancer activity.
the piperazinone containing compound with 4-quinoline cap group is more effective than other analogues for exerting selective HDAC8 inhibiting and cytotoxic activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of new hydroxamate containing HDAC8 inhibitors.
the design and synthesis of novel hydroxamic acids as potent HDAC8 inhibitors which may have potential to act as anticancer agents.
the synthesis and biological evaluation of a series of novel arylcarboxamide piperidine and arylcarboxylate piperazine based urea derivatives as potential HDAC inhibitors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the compounds with 4 quinolinyl cap group and alkylpierazine linker moieties are the most effective and selective HDACT inhibitors.
the piperazinylethyl hydroxamate scaffold containing 4 quinaldyl cap group is the best HDAC8 inhibitor with promising cytotoxic potential.
the compounds with 4 quinoly cap group with alkly piperazinylethoxy linker moieties are better than the other two groups for producing higher HDCA8 inhibitory activity and cytotoxicity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have synthesized some new hydroxamic acids containing alkylpiperidinyl and alkylpierazinyl linker moieties.
these new compounds may be used as potential anticancer agents in future.
we have designed, synthesized and evaluated some novel arylcarboxamide based hydroxamate derivatives for their HDAC inhibition and cytotoxic activity against different cancer cell types.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the compounds with piperazinone scaffold are more potent than those with piperidinone scaffold.
the piperidine and the piperazine linker moities can be used to design more potent and selective HDAC inhibitors.
the piperazinone scaffold containing hydroxamate derivatives are better HDAC8 inhibitors than the piperidinone scaffold containing derivatives.
